caption: The drawing consists of two distinct objects. The upper object is an oval wooden panel featuring a painted depiction of two human figures, a woman and a man, standing side by side. The woman is dressed in a long-sleeved, ankle-length reddish-pink dress and a tall headdress, while the man wears reddish-brown trousers, a matching vest, white stockings, brown shoes, and a black hat. Both figures are rendered standing upright against a greenish-blue background adorned with stylized floral elements, including two large flowers or fruit-like shapes, one on each side of the figures, colored in shades of orange and yellow. The bottom section of the panel has horizontal bands in lighter blue and white, suggesting either ground or a decorative border. Below the oval panel, there is a long, narrow rectangular strip embellished with a floral motif. The strip features a central flower in orange, yellow, white and red with symmetrical curling green leaves and smaller circular floral designs on each side. The colors used across both objects are predominantly shades of green, teal, red, orange, yellow, and white, with accents of black and brown. The composition is neatly arranged on a cream-colored background.
title: Bride Box
